SIMDe - SIMD Everywhere (https://github.com/simd-everywhere/simde), the headers included in motioncam-decoder's
thirdparty/simde that RawData.cpp uses (x86/sse2.h, x86/sse4.1.h and the headers they include), compiled into
libklipp_mcraw.so. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
